findings.evidence: `K ⊗[k] L` is nontrivial by `Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_flat_left`, already used in this repo at TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Connected/CommHopfAlgCat.lean:52; `connectedSpace_primeSpectrum_of_injective` (TauCeti/RingTheory/Idempotents/ConnectedSpectrum.lean:75) takes an arbitrary injective ring hom.
findings.fix: Drop the instance (rename to `.of_baseChange`) and replace `Ω := AlgebraicClosure L` by the residue field `M := (K ⊗[k] L) ⧸ 𝔪` at a maximal ideal; `L →+* M` is still injective, so the rest of the proof (`cancelBaseChange`, `Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap`, `connectedSpace_primeSpectrum_of_injective`) is unchanged.
findings.issue: `[Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K]` is stronger than the statement needs: geometric connectedness descends along an arbitrary field extension K/k. The hypothesis is an artifact of choosing `Ω := AlgebraicClosure L` and using `IsAlgClosed.lift`. Its unconditional converse `.baseChange` sits ten lines above, so the restricted form breaks the natural iff.

findings.evidence: The hypothesis is used only to produce `i : K →ₐ[k] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift` (line 75); nothing else in the proof mentions algebraicity.
findings.fix: Drop the algebraicity instance and run the same argument through a residue field of `K ⊗[k] L` instead of `AlgebraicClosure L`; the closing `isReduced_of_injective` step is unchanged.

findings.evidence: Mathlib `instance [IsCancelAdd R] [IsDomain R] [Monoid A] [UniqueProds A] : IsDomain R[A]` (Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/NoZeroDivisors.lean:132) plus `instance {ι G} [AddZeroClass G] [UniqueSums G] : UniqueSums (ι →₀ G)` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/UniqueProds/Basic.lean:470) is what the current proofs invoke; the repo's `not_isReduced_monoidAlgebra` (TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/GroupAlgebra/NotReduced.lean) is already stated for a general commutative group.
findings.fix: State both for `DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRing k G` with `(G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) [UniqueProds G]` (proof body unchanged apart from `Multiplicative (σ →₀ ℤ) ↦ G`), then obtain the split-torus versions by specialization.
findings.issue: `SplitTorus.geometricallyConnected_coordinateRing` (line 62) and `geometricallyReduced_coordinateRing` (line 84) are stated only for `characterGroup σ`, but neither proof uses freeness or finite rank — only that `MonoidAlgebra K G` has no zero divisors. The fact belongs at diagonalizable-group level, where the repo already states its negative counterpart for an arbitrary group.

summary: The two new descent theorems carry an `Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K` hypothesis the mathematics does not need, and the torus file states its core group-algebra facts only for the free character lattice while re-proving the split case of theorems it also proves for all tori.
